query:
INSERT INTO products (categoryId, name, slug, description, basePrice, isCustomizable, inStock, featured, displayOrder, productType, imageUrl) 
SELECT id, 'Freeze Dried Caramel M&Ms', 'freeze-dried-caramel-mms', 'Crunchy caramel M&Ms with an incredible texture! The caramel becomes light and airy while the chocolate shell stays perfectly intact.', '8.00', 0, 1, 1, 2, 'standard', '/images/freeze-dried-caramel-mms.png' FROM categories WHERE slug = 'freeze-dried-candy';
